description: Retry with exponential backoff, injectable sleep

signatures.name: RetryExhausted
signatures.doc: Raised when every attempt failed. Carries the last exception.

signatures.name: backoff_delays
signatures.doc: Delays between attempts. One fewer than `attempts` - the first is immediate.

signatures.name: retry
signatures.doc: Call fn until it returns. Re-raises immediately for non-retryable errors.
